name: Tile Tactile Tessellation, Grout Hairlines & Modular Slate
description: Architectural grid framework derived from ceramic tile tessellation, honed slate materiality, and precision grout hairlines. Features interlocking proportional modules (1:1, 1:2, 2:1, 2:2), 1px structural container gap lines, micro-beveled inner shadow relief, and haptic physical depression kinematics.
designPhilosophy: Rejecting detached, floating card clutter in favor of an interlocking architectural facade. Inspired by Roman mosaics and Dieter Rams modular industrial design, surfaces behave as physical ceramic tiles embedded in a structural substrate, prioritizing geometric unity, tactile micro-relief, and dignified materiality over artificial float.
appropriateUseCases: High-density developer portals, API documentation, and engineering telemetry hubs
Architecture and industrial design monographs showcasing modular works
Fintech executive dashboards and multi-instrument trading terminals
Bento-style product feature showcases demanding structural coherence
implementationApproach: 1. Grout Hairline Grid: Container employs an ultra-subtle divider color as its background (e.g. rgba(255,255,255,0.07)) with display: grid and gap: 1px, using the grid gap itself as a flawless hairline grout seam without border overlap artifacts. 2. Tactile Ceramic Relief: Tiles feature subtle dual-stop inset shading (inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.06), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) giving a machined, beveled ceramic edge. 3. Proportional Tessellation Ratios: Modules enforce strict aspect ratios (1:1 cube, 2:1 landscape slab, 1:2 vertical pillar, 2:2 focal anchor) using CSS subgrid. 4. Haptic Micro-Depression: On active state, tiles depress 1px (transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.997)) accompanied by deepened inner shadow to emulate physical switch depression. 5. Slate/Porcelain Palette: Honed slate (#121417), basalt (#0A0C0E), and bone porcelain (#EAE6DF) typography.
performanceConsiderations: Uses CSS gap and subgrid layout without nested DOM wrapper duplication. Hover and press states strictly transform translateY and scale via GPU compositing, maintaining 60fps.
accessibilityRequirements: Ensures all interactive tiles support keyboard focus rings (offset 2px with high contrast) and maintain 12:1 typography contrast on slate surfaces.
